headline: Biology-aligned components decompose single-cell perturbation and transition predictions
label: Biologically Structured Single Cell Models
summary: Virtual cell and transition models are moving from black-box embeddings toward components tied to biological mechanisms.
synthesis: The common thread across these items is structuring latent spaces or generative processes around biology so that predictions can be decomposed and interrogated. VCLMU models perturbation response as stochastic transitions over latent mechanism units, and ChromaPert conditions transcriptional responses on paired chromatin features. TempoBridge and UOT-IOT address population transitions through flow matching with minibatch optimal transport couplings and identifiable inverse optimal transport, while scCTM and residual PINNs reconstruct fate dynamics in longitudinal glioma data. Regulatory-link attention in scHPGT and mixture-of-experts structure in UniVI extend this logic to unpaired and paired multimodal integration. The set is heterogeneous: RAMP, ASTRA and c-TSNE target alignment, super-resolution and visualization rather than explicit biological structure. What is new is the shift from opaque embeddings toward components intended to correspond to biological mechanisms.
